sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops evaluation when any link in the chain is nil
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone through a chain of connections, but if any link is absent, the whole gesture dissolves into nothing.

sketches.mechanism: The 'never' return type indicates a function that can never successfully return — the type system encodes impossibility
sketches.resonance: Some departures are not choices but inevitabilities that the structure of reality itself enforces.

sketches.mechanism: A LEFT JOIN preserves every row from the left table even when no match exists on the right, filling unmatched columns with NULL
sketches.resonance: We keep every person in the result, but where a companion should be, there is only absence.
sketches.draft:
SELECT
  everyone.id,
  someone.id
FROM everyone
LEFT JOIN someone
  ON everyone.id = someone.id
WHERE someone.id IS NULL;
